### Lean into God's Compassion
Author: Jessica Van Roekel
Site: Crosswalk.com
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/crosswalk-devo/lean-into-gods-compassion-the-crosswalk-devotional.html
Passage: Psalm 86:15-16
Points:
- God is patient, gracious, and abundant in steadfast love toward His people.
- True compassion feels another's pain and actively steps forward to help.
- Like Jonah, believers often gladly receive God's mercy while hesitating to extend it to others.
- Remembering our own continuous need for forgiveness cultivates humility and softens anger.

### God Wants to Prepare You for Today
Author: Lysa TerKeurst
Site: Crosswalk.com
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/encouragement/encouragement-for-today-october-8-2026.html
Passage: Psalm 86:11
Points:
- Starting the morning in prayerful meditation on Scripture silences worldly worries.
- Asking for an undivided heart helps us follow God's truth instead of fluctuating emotions.
- God's great love for us is unconditional and not tied to flawless personal performance.
- Daily interruptions become spiritual opportunities when faced with God's peace and strength.

### An Undivided Heart for Busy Days
Author: Amanda Idleman
Site: Crosswalk.com
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/your-nightly-prayer/an-undivided-heart-for-busy-days.html
Passage: Psalm 86:11
Points:
- Racing thoughts and demanding schedules scatter our attention and rob us of restorative rest.
- Jesus invites the weary to lay down their burdens and rely on His gentle yoke.
- Believers are created primarily for communion and worship rather than endless productivity.
- Entrusting our to-do lists to God's faithful care anchors the heart in peaceful sleep.

### Wisdom from the Psalms 7/11
Author: Crosswalk.com
Site: Crosswalk.com
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/wisdom/wisdom-from-the-psalms-7-or-11-552440.html
Passage: Psalm 86:17
Points:
- The Lord gives clear evidence of His goodness through transformed human lives.
- Genuine changes from past wrongdoing into grace and humility point observers toward God.
- When others witness God's comforting help in our lives, their hearts are softened.
- Offering our lives to God's guidance allows Him to use our restoration to encourage others.
